title: TNR Gold NSR Royalty Update - McEwen Provides Update on NSR Royalty on Los Azules Copper
summary: Vancouver, British Columbia--(Newsfile Corp. - August 10, 2026) - TNR Gold Corp. (TSXV: TNR) ("TNR", "TNR Gold" or the "Company") is pleased to advise that McEwen Inc. ("McEwen") has announced an update on the Los Azules copper, gold and silver project in San Juan, Argentina. TNR holds a 0.4% net smelter returns royalty ("NSR Royalty") (of which 0.04% of the 0.4% NSR Royalty is held on behalf of a shareholder) on the Los Azules Copper Project. The Los Azules project is held by McEwen Copper Inc.
